purpose: Minimize additional Lean code while kernel-verifying the supplied completed computer-assisted proof.
supplied_completed_proof: ledger_2026-10-07c accepted as research input; formalize its argument and evidence, not a new numerical search.

required_components.reuse: Existing quartet normalization, finite-corner classification, strict actual-matrix reconstruction and equivalence lemmas.
required_components.remaining: Derive the exact strict maximal, sorted, positive-sheet campaign domain from an actual quartet, with all degenerate and exceptional alternatives excluded by checked endpoints. Formalize only the classification consequences actually used.

required_components.reuse: Existing exact interval, graph, phase-cover and scalar/physical lemmas.
required_components.remaining: Connect each used terminal rule to the actual physical matrix, common unbiased rays or non-maximal corner. Reuse a common consumer across regular and shoulder data. Correct guards and continuum semantics are required.

required_components.reuse: Completed campaign data and proof recipes, plus existing finite-cover kernels.
required_components.remaining: Retrieve full witness payloads and exact geometry/index maps, or emit witnesses by replaying the completed calculations; kernel-check acceptance, refinement children and a complete covering union, including boundaries. Receipt statuses and hashes are provenance, not proof of exclusion.
Compose the checked reduction, covering union, terminal soundness and exceptional exclusions. Audit the final theorem without additional research axioms.

priorities: Reuse/admit already kernel-checked strict physical endpoints; do not rebuild the general classification.
Bind actual witness data to reusable consumers, prioritizing regular/shoulder Stage-C and the required F6 tube.
Use one proved local theorem plus checked containment to compress a family when that is shorter than checking all its individual certificates.
Check complete chunks and coverage once a consumer works; repeated acceptance of the same pilot roots adds no new coverage.
unnecessary_for_this_route: Lean translations of the search engine, schedulers, cluster controls, optimizer, heuristics or all producer software.
One handwritten theorem per numerical box.
Reproducing the native ledger priority order when an exact sound covering union suffices.
New radius-extension or global confinement research; the latest repository still calls confinement open.
General candidate cardinalities, stronger classification results or unused sufficiency corollaries.
Rebuilding all Mathlib or porting independent historical proof routes.

trust_boundary.external_generation: An untrusted converter may propose exact certificates and generated Lean proof terms.
trust_boundary.acceptance: All mathematical acceptance and coverage must be kernel checked; no axiom or status flag may replace missing evidence.
trust_boundary.dependency_caveat: Preserve the recorded Mathlib source/cache authenticity caveat; this planning record does not resolve it.
trust_boundary.admission: Successful guarded replay, axiom audit, independent semantic review, and exact source/object/import pins remain required.
